assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Edge-computing / data-element station PUE target <= 1.3 is a design target benchmarked to typical green-data-center references (e.g., advanced hyperscale / edge DC PUE ~1.2-1.4), not a measured value. Actual PUE depends on final equipment, cooling scheme, and load profile; to be calibrated after official engineering conditions are released.
assumptions.impact: Used as a directional design target in metrics_evidence; not a committed performance baseline.

assumptions.statement: Service availability target >= 99% for public-facing AI wayfinding / sensing nodes is a design target derived from typical public-service SLA references. Actual availability depends on redundancy, power, and maintenance arrangements; to be confirmed during pilot.
assumptions.impact: Used as a directional design target in metrics_evidence; not a measured baseline.

assumptions.statement: Service-point density target of one reachable node per ~500 m is a walkability design heuristic (consistent with 5-10 min walk / ~400-600 m public-service catchment norms), not a site-surveyed value. Final spacing depends on key-area layout and official public-space allocation.
assumptions.impact: Used as a directional design target in metrics_evidence; not a surveyed baseline.

assumptions.statement: Breakpoint closed-loop response windows (general <= 7 days, complex <= 15 days) are design-service-level targets benchmarked to typical municipal 12345 / public-facility response norms; not statutory deadlines. Final SLAs to be set with operating entity and confirmed by authority.
assumptions.impact: Used as a directional design target in metrics_evidence; not a statutory baseline.
